    • mapToTargetModel

      default T mapToTargetModel(S sourceModel, org.apache.camel.Exchange exchange)
      Maps the given sourceModel to the target type.

      The default implementation simply forwards the mapping to mapToTargetModel(Object) and omits the given excchange.

      Parameters:
      sourceModel - Element to map
      exchange - Current exchange
      Returns:
      Element mapped to target type

    • process

      default void process(org.apache.camel.Exchange exchange) throws SIPFrameworkException
      Maps from source to target model using the ConnectorExtension API.

      The default implementation uses mapToTargetModel(Object, Exchange) to map the current message body to the target type.

      Specified by:
      process in interface org.apache.camel.Processor
      Parameters:
      exchange - Current message exchange
